name: Dual-Pass Differentiable Volume Rendering with Sparse Gradient Recording
aliases: Differentiable Renderer based on Differential RTE
definition: A differentiable rendering technique that executes forward and backward passes concurrently to reuse the Jacobian term J_ss during backpropagation, utilizing a sparse structure gradRec to store gradients only along sampled ray paths rather than the entire volume grid.
summary: Dual-Pass Differentiable Volume Rendering is a technique that concurrently executes forward and backward passes while storing gradients sparsely along ray paths to reduce memory usage and avoid reliance on automatic differentiation.
